title: Two p-block oxides
caption: Phosphorus(V) oxide, P₄O₁₀, is a cage of four tetrahedral phosphorus atoms bridged by oxygens, each also double-bonded to one oxygen. Sulfur trioxide, SO₃, is a trigonal planar molecule. Both react with water to give strong acids.
alt: The P₄O₁₀ cage and the SO₃ molecule.
description: P₄O₁₀: four P atoms, six bridging O atoms and four terminal P=O.
SO₃: sulfur double-bonded to three oxygens, trigonal planar.
